# The examples

What the checker and the shapes each say of every example and plant of this profile. It lists what the tests hold, never what a run printed. Only this profile's own plants are here; every other parcel's crate plants are held to the shapes' soundness and not listed (a page every parcel's plants regenerate is a merge conflict).

Where the checker says `accepted but for step 9`, steps 1 to 8 held and only step 9 refused, since the fixture's generator did not make the edited metadata: so every must shape has to conform. The `abstains` family is the exception, and says so: the reader refuses those crates' ids (FORMAT.md item 22), so the checker has refused them and the evaluator abstains; a real engine reads them its own way, and the matrix says what it fails, on crates refused first, by a name the failing shape claims (limit 19: every must shape claims `spelling` and `graph-form`).

### made from the table

For each term of the vocabulary, one plant gives it a value in none of its spelling, on an entity its domain admits (`spell-` and the term): the checker refuses `spelling`, and the term's shape fails. For each term whose domain is not `*`, one puts it, in its spelling, on an entity of a type its domain does not admit (`domain-` and the term): the checker refuses `graph-form`, and the domain shape fails. A term whose bad value is held first by another rule of the reader says so in the tests.
